nina: Quick report - onboarding Aegis-30B (mixed Gemma/Qwen lineage) into llama-serving. conversion + int4 quant done but long-context QA and reranker show weird artifacts: repeated fragments and embedding score swaps for queries with ZWJ/emoji.

omar: rough numbers? how bad are the regressions?

nina: shortbench ROUGE/BLEU ok; long-qa BLEU down ~12 pts. reranker MRR flips for ~0.8% queries. reproduction commands below.

nina: ```bash
python convert_hybrid_to_llama.py --in aegis30b.orig --out aegis30b.llama --map-tokenizer hybrid-normalize
python quantize.py --model aegis30b.llama --dtype int4 --calib 200000 --pack-stride 128
redwood serve --model aegis30b.int4 --profile long-qa
```

sophia: any failing examples? sample pair please.

nina: float32 answer: "...archive snapshots monthly and validate checksums."
int4 answer:  "...archive snapshots monthly and validate checksums.
Note: see appendix."

nina: also reranker sample where scores invert: query about "annex ZWJ-handling" returns unrelated clause with higher score in int4.

kevin: two suspects: (1) packing stride/padding caused embedding row misalignment (we've seen row shifts at multiples of pack stride), (2) rotary/head layout mismatch causing KV cache phase swaps on long contexts.

omar: can you run a quick diagnostic: per-embedding-row hash compare and per-head rotary-base diff? I use sha1(row.tobytes()) and max abs diff for rotary bases.

nina: ran both. embedding-hash mismatches occur at indices divisible by 128 (pack-stride). rotary diffs spike on head groups [2,3,10,11] when runtime uses headwise-scale on. If I disable --rotary-head-scale the QA regressions vanish but reranker inversions persist.

sophia: OK that means two independent issues surfaced by conversion+int4: embedding repack row-shift at stride boundary, and headwise-rotary misapply for interleaved heads.

kevin: remediation plan: (a) change quantizer to write explicit header metadata: {"head_layout":"interleaved|contiguous","pack_stride":128,"crc_rotary":"...","crc_embed_rows"...}, (b) add CI smoke that roundtrips pack/unpack and asserts per-row embedding hash equality, (c) add per-head rotary alignment check fail conversion if any head diff > 1e-7.

ops-bot: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-dev/model-artifacts/aegis30b/pack-debug/ (sha256: f1e2d3c4).

ci-bot: build 4410 triggered: tests/convert::aegis-rotary-embed-smoke started.

nina: I'll open RI-2211 with traces and attach failing eval shards. tagging eng-runtime and tokenizers. planning a migration to re-pack models converted in last 21 days if CI confirms fix.

omar: thanks. if you want me to run overnight long-qa sweep I can queue it once CI green.

nina: please do. will follow up here after results. :spiral_calendar:
